DELIMITER $$
CREATE TRIGGER `product_update_status_trigger` BEFORE UPDATE ON `products_list` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
    IF NEW.quantity = 0 THEN
        SET NEW.status = 0;
    END IF;
END
$$
DELIMITER ;
DELIMITER $$
CREATE TRIGGER `product_update_status_trigger_add` BEFORE UPDATE ON `products_list` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
    IF NEW.quantity > 0 THEN
        SET NEW.status = 1;
    END IF;
END
$$
DELIMITER ;

DELIMITER $$
CREATE TRIGGER `delete_expired_tokens` BEFORE INSERT ON `resetpassword` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
    -- Calculate the time difference in minutes
    SET @current_time = NOW();
    SET @token_time = NEW.created_at;
    SET @time_difference = TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, @token_time, @current_time);
    -- If the time difference is greater than 10 minutes, delete the row
    IF @time_difference > 10 THEN
        DELETE FROM resetpassword WHERE token = NEW.token;
    END IF;
END
$$
DELIMITER ;
